key_path: Consumer agent path (fastest): add Claude connector https://mcp.uber.com/claude/rides-3p/mcp (rides price/ETA estimates) and/or https://mcp.ubereats.com/eats-claude/mcp (restaurant/menu browse) -> OAuth sign-in to Uber account (phone OTP) -> use. Booking/checkout hands off to the Uber app.
Developer path: sign in to developer.uber.com dashboard with an Uber account -> Register App -> pick product (e.g. Rides/Guest Rides) -> accept terms -> get client_id/secret.

Request privileged scope (guests.trips, business.*, eats.*) from Uber / Uber for Business rep with org name, admin email, client id, use case and endpoint list -> wait for approval -> enable scope in dashboard.
client_credentials token -> call sandbox (sandbox-api.uber.com/v1/guests/) -> production after review.

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: unknown - endpoints returned plain 403 'access denied' to our unauthenticated probe from India (no WWW-Authenticate / PRM), suggesting client/geo allowlisting rather than open DCR; connectors work inside Claude
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - OAuth scopes, but useful ones are privileged
agent_native_auth.free_tier: API free but gated; consumer connector free with Uber account

mcp.directories: Claude directory: 'Uber' and 'Uber Eats' (launched with Claude consumer connectors, Apr 2026). URLs are Claude-specific paths ('/claude/', '/eats-claude/'). ChatGPT Uber/Uber Eats apps reported by secondary sources.
agentic_commerce_protocols: none public; hand-off to Uber app

docs_for_agents.openapi: partial - per-product specs (e.g. guest-rides/all-spec), Postman collections
docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: no AI-specific rules; general * disallows /api/ and some paths

score_justification: Polished first-party consumer connectors in Claude, but they are estimate/browse-only, look client-allowlisted, and the developer APIs sit behind privileged-scope approval with no agent-oriented docs.
best_practice: Consumer MCPs scoped to safe read actions (estimates, menus) with booking/payment handed off to the native app.
biggest_gap: No self-serve API for ride requests; no llms.txt/markdown docs; MCP endpoints are per-client paths rather than one open DCR server.
